scope: Proposition 1.15 of the manuscript “A uniform Hilbert transform estimate for Lipschitz directions” (preprints/A-uniform-Hilbert-transform-estimate-for-Lipschitz-directions-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 083 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 38d5c48b4d835003), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that the following bounds hold, uniformly for every admissible finite form ΛS in Theorem 1.13, with the fixed packet constants there. The field u : R2 → R is bounded and measurable, the sets F, E ⊂ R2 are measurable with positive finite measure, and the input and test satisfy ∥f(z)∥H ≤ 1F (z), ∥g(z)∥H ≤ 1E(z). (i) For m ≥ 1, there is a fixed exponent C1 such that |ΛS(f, g)| ≤ C(1 + log(2m))C1 q |F||E|. (1.38) (ii) For L ≥ L0, with τ, m, W as in (1.17), assume in addition that |u| ≤ 1, Lip(u) ≤ CLip, and F, E ⊂ I × R for an interval I with |I| ≤ b0. Whenever L/2 ≤ log p |E|/|F| ≤ 2L, |ΛS(f, g)| ≤ CL−20 q |F||E|. (1.39) (iii) For m = 1, one scalar component, and |E| ≤ |F|, there is a fixed c > 0 such that |ΛS(f, g)| ≤ C q |F||E|(|E|/|F|)c . (1.40) Then Theorem 1.4 holds. The constants remain uniform in w, ϵ, and the number of retained scales.
